schema.text: To what extent does using public transport affect your sense of social comfort or personal image?

options.text: I would rather not be seen using public transport
I sometimes feel uncomfortable using public transport in certain social situations
I occasionally feel out of place or self-conscious when using this service in certain social situations
I don't feel that my choice of transport has any connection to my social standing or identity
I feel comfortable and confident using this mode of transport in social settings

en.#To what extent does using public transp: To what extent does using public transport affect your sense of social comfort or personal image?
en.#I would rather not be seen using public: I would rather not be seen using public transport
en.#I sometimes feel uncomfortable using pu: I sometimes feel uncomfortable using public transport in certain social situations
en.#I occasionally feel out of place or sel: I occasionally feel out of place or self-conscious when using this service in certain social situations
en.#I don't feel that my choice of transpor: I don't feel that my choice of transport has any connection to my social standing or identity
en.#I feel comfortable and confident using: I feel comfortable and confident using this mode of transport in social settings

it.#To what extent does using public transp: In che misura l'utilizzo del trasporto pubblico influisce sul tuo comfort sociale o sulla tua immagine personale?
it.#I would rather not be seen using public: Preferirei non essere visto/a mentre utilizzo il trasporto pubblico
it.#I sometimes feel uncomfortable using pu: A volte mi sento a disagio nell'utilizzare il trasporto pubblico in determinate situazioni sociali
it.#I occasionally feel out of place or sel: Occasionalmente mi sento fuori posto o a disagio nell'utilizzare questo servizio in determinate situazioni sociali
it.#I don't feel that my choice of transpor: Non ritengo che la mia scelta del mezzo di trasporto abbia alcun legame con la mia posizione sociale o la mia identità
it.#I feel comfortable and confident using: Mi sento a mio agio e sicuro/a nell'utilizzare questa modalità di trasporto in contesti sociali

fr.#To what extent does using public transp: Dans quelle mesure l’utilisation des transports publics influence-t-elle votre aisance dans les situations sociales ou l’image que vous avez de vous-même ?
fr.#I would rather not be seen using public: Je préférerais que les autres ne me voient pas utiliser les transports publics
fr.#I sometimes feel uncomfortable using pu: Je me sens parfois mal à l’aise d’utiliser les transports publics dans certaines situations sociales
fr.#I occasionally feel out of place or sel: Dans certaines situations sociales, il m’arrive de me sentir déplacé(e) ou gêné(e) lorsque j’utilise ce service
fr.#I don't feel that my choice of transpor: Je ne pense pas que mon choix de transport soit lié à mon statut social ou à mon identité
fr.#I feel comfortable and confident using: Je me sens à l’aise et en confiance lorsque j’utilise ce mode de transport dans des situations sociales

de.#To what extent does using public transp: Wie stark beeinflusst die Nutzung öffentlicher Verkehrsmittel Ihr Wohlbefinden in sozialen Situationen oder Ihr persönliches Selbstbild?
de.#I would rather not be seen using public: Ich würde lieber nicht dabei gesehen werden, öffentliche Verkehrsmittel zu nutzen
de.#I sometimes feel uncomfortable using pu: In manchen sozialen Situationen fühle ich mich bei der Nutzung öffentlicher Verkehrsmittel unwohl
de.#I occasionally feel out of place or sel: In manchen sozialen Situationen fühle ich mich bei der Nutzung dieses Angebots fehl am Platz oder beobachtet
de.#I don't feel that my choice of transpor: Ich sehe keinen Zusammenhang zwischen meiner Verkehrsmittelwahl und meinem sozialen Status oder meiner Identität
de.#I feel comfortable and confident using: Ich fühle mich wohl und sicher, wenn ich dieses Verkehrsmittel in sozialen Situationen nutze

tr.#To what extent does using public transp: Toplu taşıma kullanmak sosyal ortamlarda rahatlık hissinizi veya kendinizle ilgili algınızı ne ölçüde etkiler?
tr.#I would rather not be seen using public: Toplu taşıma kullanırken başkalarının beni görmemesini tercih ederim
tr.#I sometimes feel uncomfortable using pu: Bazı sosyal durumlarda toplu taşıma kullanırken kendimi rahatsız hissederim
tr.#I occasionally feel out of place or sel: Bazı sosyal durumlarda bu hizmeti kullanırken kendimi ait değilmiş veya fazla dikkat çekiyormuş gibi hissederim
tr.#I don't feel that my choice of transpor: Ulaşım tercihim ile sosyal statüm veya kimliğim arasında bir bağlantı olduğunu düşünmüyorum
tr.#I feel comfortable and confident using: Sosyal ortamlarda bu ulaşım seçeneğini kullanırken kendimi rahat ve güvende hissederim

fa.#To what extent does using public transp: استفاده از حمل‌ونقل عمومی تا چه اندازه بر احساس راحتی شما در موقعیت‌های اجتماعی یا برداشت شما از خودتان اثر می‌گذارد؟
fa.#I would rather not be seen using public: ترجیح می‌دهم دیگران مرا هنگام استفاده از حمل‌ونقل عمومی نبینند
fa.#I sometimes feel uncomfortable using pu: در بعضی موقعیت‌های اجتماعی هنگام استفاده از حمل‌ونقل عمومی احساس ناراحتی می‌کنم
fa.#I occasionally feel out of place or sel: در بعضی موقعیت‌های اجتماعی هنگام استفاده از این سرویس احساس می‌کنم به آن محیط تعلق ندارم یا بیش از حد مورد توجه هستم
fa.#I don't feel that my choice of transpor: فکر نمی‌کنم انتخاب وسیله رفت‌وآمد من ارتباطی با جایگاه اجتماعی یا هویتم داشته باشد
fa.#I feel comfortable and confident using: در موقعیت‌های اجتماعی هنگام استفاده از این روش رفت‌وآمد احساس راحتی و اطمینان می‌کنم

hu.#To what extent does using public transp: Mennyire befolyásolja a tömegközlekedés használata, hogy mennyire érzi magát kényelmesen társas helyzetekben vagy hogyan látja saját magát?
hu.#I would rather not be seen using public: Inkább nem szeretném, ha mások látnák, hogy tömegközlekedést használok
hu.#I sometimes feel uncomfortable using pu: Bizonyos társas helyzetekben kellemetlenül érzem magam a tömegközlekedés használata miatt
hu.#I occasionally feel out of place or sel: Bizonyos társas helyzetekben néha úgy érzem, hogy nem illeszkedem oda, vagy túlzottan figyelnek rám
hu.#I don't feel that my choice of transpor: Nem érzem úgy, hogy a közlekedési módom összefüggne a társadalmi helyzetemmel vagy az identitásommal
hu.#I feel comfortable and confident using: Társas helyzetekben is kényelmesen és magabiztosan használom ezt a közlekedési módot

ar.#To what extent does using public transp: إلى أي مدى يؤثر استخدام النقل العام في شعورك بالراحة في المواقف الاجتماعية أو في نظرتك إلى نفسك؟
ar.#I would rather not be seen using public: أفضل ألا يراني الآخرون وأنا أستخدم النقل العام
ar.#I sometimes feel uncomfortable using pu: أشعر أحيانًا بعدم الراحة عند استخدام النقل العام في بعض المواقف الاجتماعية
ar.#I occasionally feel out of place or sel: أشعر أحيانًا بأنني غير منسجم مع المكان أو أنني ملفت للانتباه عند استخدام هذه الخدمة في بعض المواقف الاجتماعية
ar.#I don't feel that my choice of transpor: لا أشعر أن اختياري لوسيلة النقل مرتبط بمكانتي الاجتماعية أو هويتي
ar.#I feel comfortable and confident using: أشعر بالراحة والثقة عند استخدام هذه الوسيلة في المواقف الاجتماعية
